name: terminal-pilot
description: Playwright-like SDK for automating interactive CLI apps through a real PTY

scripts.test:
cd ../.. && vitest run $(rg --files packages/terminal-pilot/src -g '*.test.ts' | sort | tr '
' ' ')
scripts.test:unit:
cd ../.. && vitest run $(rg --files packages/terminal-pilot/src -g '*.test.ts' | sort | tr '
' ' ')
scripts.install-local-package: TMPD=$(mktemp -d) && npm pack --pack-destination $TMPD && npm install -g $TMPD/terminal-pilot-*.tgz && rm -rf $TMPD
